episodeReviews.scope: All 23 narrative and 6 trivia captions checked against 113 selected records, with individually cited released stills and selected own-profile identities. Not a complete frame, background, weapon or credit inventory.
notes: Young Hera and Chopper reuse their existing identities. Gobi is an existing family friend; the own Databank says he treats Hera like a niece. The narrative’s uncle address does not establish biological kinship. Caption 5 inconsistently attributes an objection during Gobi’s conversation to Cham; no exact speaker fact is derived from that sentence.

Crosshair shoots Orn Free Taa; the next episode explicitly calls it an assassination attempt. No death fact is created. The trivia spelling Orn Free Ta is not another person. Eleni’s earlier photos/illustrations and Clone Wars production callbacks are not earlier living scenes certified by this batch.
